CMDLINE: "/opt/oai-nr-ue/bin/nr-uesoftmodem" "--help" 

-----Help for section (root section)            : 038 entries------
    --usrp-args: set the arguments to identify USRP (same syntax as in UHD)
    --tx_subdev: set the arguments to select tx_subdev (same syntax as in UHD)
    --rx_subdev: set the arguments to select rx_subdev (same syntax as in UHD)
    --dlsch-parallel: number of threads for dlsch processing 0 for no parallelization
    --offset-divisor: Divisor for computing OFDM symbol offset in Rx chain (num samples in CP/<the value>). Default value is 8. To set the sample offset to 0, set this value ~ 10e6
    --max-ldpc-iterations: Maximum LDPC decoder iterations
    -V: Enable VCD (generated file will is named openair_dump_eNB.vcd, read it with target/RT/USER/eNB.gtkw
    --uecap_file: path for UE Capabilities file
    --reconfig-file: filename for reconfig.raw in phy-test mode
    --rbconfig-file: filename for rbconfig.raw in phy-test mode
    --ue-rxgain: set UE RX gain
    --ue-txgain: set UE TX gain
    --ue-nb-ant-rx: set UE number of rx antennas
    --ue-nb-ant-tx: set UE number of tx antennas
    --ue-scan-carrier: set UE to scan all possible GSCN in current bandwidth
    --ue-fo-compensation: set UE to enable estimation and compensation of frequency offset
    --ue-max-power: Help string not specified
    -r: Set the number of PRBs for SA
    --ssb: Set the start subcarrier 
    --if_freq: IF frequency for RF, if needed
    --if_freq_off: UL IF frequency offset for RF, if needed
    --chest-freq: Set channel estimation type in frequency domain. 0-Linear interpolation (default). 1-PRB based averaging of channel estimates in frequency. 
    --chest-time: Set channel estimation type in time domain. 0-Symbols take estimates of the last preceding DMRS symbol (default). 1-Symbol based averaging of channel estimates in time. 
    --ue-timing-correction-disable: disable UE timing correction
    --SLC: Set the sidelink frequency for all component carriers
    --num-ues: Help string not specified
    --time-sync-P: coefficient for Proportional part of time sync PI controller
    --time-sync-I: coefficient for Integrating part of time sync PI controller
    --ntn-initial-time-drift: Initial NTN DL time drift (feeder link and service link), given in µs/s
    --autonomous-ta: Autonomously update TA based on DL drift (useful if main contribution to DL drift is movement, e.g. LEO satellite)
    --initial-fo: Initially compensated DL frequency offset (e.g. known Doppler shift in NTN LEO scenario)
    --freq-sync-P: coefficient for Proportional part of continuous frequency offset compensation PI controller
    --freq-sync-I: coefficient for Integrating part of continuous frequency offset compensation PI controller
    --cont-fo-comp: Enable continuous frequency offset (FO) estimation and (pre-)compensation and specify main FO source (1 = local oscillator, 2 = Doppler shift, 3 = Don't consider residual DL FO in UL FO pre-compensation)
    --agc: Rx Gain control used for UE
    --num-ul-actors: Number of UL actors to use. Set to 0 to disable UL actor framework and do processing inline
    --num-dl-actors: Number of DL actors to use. Set to 0 to disable DL actor framework and do processing inline
    --extra-pdu-id: ID of an additional PDU session to configure alongside default PDU session

    --thread-pool: Thread pool configuration: 
  list of cores, comma separated (negative value is no core affinity)

    --phy-test: test UE phy layer, mac disabled
    --do-ra: test gNB  and UE with RA procedures

    --clock-source: tells hardware to use a clock reference (0:internal, 1:ext[UTIL]   running in SA mode (no --phy-test, --do-ra, --nsa option present)
